response.justification: While Bogdan has 20 years of solid engineering experience with strong backend and microservices fundamentals, he lacks the critical requirements for this CTO role. He has no demonstrated production experience building and operating multi-agent AI systems at scale, minimal fintech-infrastructure background (no credit systems, payment flows, or embedded finance experience), and no clear track record of scaling engineering teams from 10 to 30+ people or leading in regulated financial environments. His current re:cinq role (4 months) shows recent pivot into AI infrastructure, but insufficient depth and tenure to evidence the executive-level leadership and domain expertise required.
strengths: Strong 20-year backend engineering foundation with proven microservices and distributed-systems experience at scale (millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby)
Demonstrated versatility across tech stacks and commitment to engineering culture through TDD, CI/CD practices, and knowledge-sharing via workshops and mentorship
Recent directional alignment toward AI infrastructure and agentic frameworks in current re:cinq role shows interest in target domain
concerns: Only ~4 months production experience with agentic AI systems; no portfolio of deployed multi-agent systems or evidence of shipping at scale
Zero demonstrated fintech infrastructure background—no credit systems, payment flows, working-capital management, or regulated environment experience
Resume lacks evidence of executive-level team scaling or large-organization leadership; senior/staff roles described but no clear record of building and managing 10–30+ person engineering teams

key_factors.factor: Production agentic AI systems at scale
Proven engineering team scaling and leadership
